gather_issue WIN via strip-major coalesce. focus_c8 [1,1,1024,256] W2->H8 chunk8: baseline 17633-17745ns, hoist 17705-17872 (NULL), strip 14553-14704 (1.20x), scratch 191k (0.09x REGRESSION). gated W4 chunk4: 23687->12031 (1.97x). Mechanism: gather is NOT RISC-issue-bound at 8 dst cores (hoist flat); it is bound by a shared ~33-36 GB/s NoC ceiling reached at >=512B transfers. Uncontended (1 dst core) it IS issue-bound: hoist 1.62x, strip 3.88x. Op-level: non-read cost 3029ns@chunk8 vs 3226ns@chunk4 -> consumer-side cost of sub-block tilize bounded at ~200ns.
